# A pane's header: Close is always there; split, float and zoom come in
# with the pointer, so a split of several panes isn't a row of icons on each.
# (pane-headers = always is the default; a split gives both panes one.)
expect-header-buttons:Close Pane
header-pointer:on
expect-header-buttons:Split Right,Split Down,Float Pane,Zoom Pane,Close Pane
header-pointer:off
expect-header-buttons:Close Pane
key:cmd+d
wait:1.0
expect-panes:2
expect-header-buttons:Close Pane
header-pointer:on
expect-header-buttons:Split Right,Split Down,Float Pane,Zoom Pane,Close Pane
header-pointer:off
shot:pane-header.png
